network.description:
The network on which validators should be created. Supported values;
- mainnet
- testnet
- devnet

start.description: It specifies the start epoch if the type is 1, or the start date in the "YYYY-MM-DD" format (UTC timezone) if the type is 2.

end.description: It specifies the end epoch if the type is 1, or the end date in the "YYYY-MM-DD" format (UTC timezone) if the type is 2.

stake_accounts.description: List of delegator stake accounts to fetch the rewards breakdown. A maximum of 50 entries are allowed.

items.description: List of delegator stake accounts to fetch the rewards breakdown. A maximum of 50 entries are allowed.
